project.stack: Next.js/React/TypeScript web and React Native/Expo mobile; same Supabase backend retained. No Flutter migration authorized.
project.ownership: Repertoire/chat/homework/home/auth/shell are native targets. Profile/choristers/announcements/attendance are permanent WebView. UI pixel parity is not a requirement.
project.contract: Platform-free choir-context-core TypeScript uses injected RPC client and preference hints; database RPC revalidates user/session. Annotation types are a shared TypeScript source.
project.server: New server behavior for native screens goes into Supabase Edge and web reuses it. Schema changes require backup/restore, sibling-site assessment and ordered DB/Edge/client rollout.
project.state: PDF gateway uses operationVersion, AbortController and cleanup to stop late publication. WebView recovery validates issuer/family/query and current native lease; only one recovery and confirmed denials are final.
project.limitation: lib/chat.ts imports a web Supabase singleton and mixes data access and pure name/URL functions. It cannot all be copied as platform-free code.
project.gap: Known primary-agent finding: performance submission query lacks current_file_version_id and HomeworkCard prefers drive_web_view_link. Actual local WebView recovery is not complete assignment-version Drive-exit.
project.acceptance: 090 has connected local native PDF and actual WebView recovery; synthetic unsigned audio lifecycle. Overlapping HTTP/COMMIT, connected audio, native iOS, hosted R2 and physical device/release remain unrun.
project.business: Independent choirs, multi-choir users, operator-assisted first-version onboarding, five free members then additional-seat billing. Pricing/seat accounting/retention/last-chef policy are owner choices, not model choices.
project.AI: Jev is text-only and returns typed judgments; no tools or prose generation. Deterministic Auth/RLS owns candidate retrieval; never send other-tenant candidates. No current runtime integration proposed.

state.constraints: Preserve Android-first beta critical path. No hosted release today. No AI authorization or unauthorized framework/lifecycle change.
state.authoritative_order: Current repository handoff explicitly names overlapping HTTP/authority-COMMIT acceptance as NEXT ready local outcome; performance query/HomeworkCard current-version integration follows. The current source order is binding; these questions may not reorder it. Product AI is later than beta blockers.
